newsitem.title: USA: Biomerica says founder, CEO Irani died.
newsitem.headline: Biomerica says founder, CEO Irani died.

text.p: BIOMERICA INC said its founder, chairman and chief executive officer Joseph Irani, has died from natural causes.
The company has appointed two new board members, Janet Moore and Zackary Irani. Moore was elected as the new Chairperson of the Board of Directors. Irani has been appointed as the interim CEO.
Janet Moore has served the company for over 20 years, most recently as controller and secretary. Zackary Irani, the Vice President of Business Development, has served the company for over 10 years.
